recap.text: D'nadia sits on Ripper Wonton's Danger Zone panel while a crawler and his cat appear. The Skull Empire fires at the pair but hits Manasa instead. D'nadia tells a comedian to shut his mouth for treating the death as political arithmetic and announces on air that the Prism Kingdom will bring a grievance against the Skull Empire in the Syndicate Courts.

Empress D'nadia judges the talent show and pet contest while Chaco runs the prize counter. She tells a crawler that he and his attorney nearly ruined her buy-in bid. She tells a half-naiad that a bug's mother controls the deity and that Carl will not survive the night. D'nadia bought the Prism Kingdom in her own name.

D'nadia enters the playing field as warlord of the Prism Kingdom Clan. She tells Donut she liked her song and offers the table a meal at restaurants in Larracos, though a naga says this is not advisable. D'nadia sells her sponsorship of Princess Donut because she may fight the crawler.

Crawler Carl marks Empress D'nadia of the Prism Kingdom with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering, and Mongo kills her. D'nadia says she acted for her people, but Carl tells her she acted for herself and her people will pay.

beats.headline: A seat on the Danger Zone panel
beats.text: Ripper Wonton's panel, and the crawler and his cat are on it. I keep reaching for his hand and my claws keep going straight through his fingers, which does not stop me reaching. Then the Skull Empire fire at those two and hit Manasa instead. My friend. The comedian starts treating her death as a piece of political arithmetic, and I tell him to shut his mouth. The Prism Kingdom condemns the action, and I say so on air within the hour: we will bring a grievance against the Skull Empire in the Syndicate Courts.
beats.gist: D'nadia tells a comedian to shut his mouth after the Skull Empire hits Manasa.

beats.headline: Empress, judging the pet contest
beats.text: The ball, and I am judging the talent show and the pet contest both. Chaco is running the prize counter. I find the crawler in the crowd and tell him the truth of it: he and his attorney very nearly ruined my buy-in bid, and here I am regardless, judging, which makes me production.
beats.gist: Empress D'nadia judges a talent show and pet contest while Chaco runs the prize counter.

beats.headline: What she tells the elite
beats.text: The half-naiad sits with the judges for most of the evening deep in conversation, and I tell her a great deal. The whole universe has been looking forward to this party. More people than there are stars in the sky are watching. The deity is under the control of that bug's mother, who sold half of everything she owns to get here. Her own mother was never real; nor were her friends. And I am sad Carl won't survive the night. I was looking forward to meeting him on the battlefield outside Larracos.
beats.gist: D'nadia tells the elite that the deity is under the control of a bug's mother.

beats.headline: One of the two places
beats.text: Two places in the ninth floor's war came up at once. One of them is mine: the Prism Kingdom's, bought in my own name where anybody watching could watch me do it. The other went to a brand-new non-profit corporation. I know exactly whose that is.
beats.gist: D'nadia buys the Prism Kingdom in her own name during a war.

beats.headline: Empress, and free for dinner
beats.text: I have just onboarded onto the playing field as warlord of the Prism Kingdom Clan, and Donut calls me Princess before correcting herself to Empress, which is right. I tell her I really liked her song the other night and I am sorry they kicked us out before the festivities really started. When it is my turn I introduce myself properly and tell the table that if anyone wants to catch a meal, I am available. A few restaurants in Larracos have finally opened back up. The naga says that is not advisable.
beats.gist: D'nadia joins the playing field as warlord of the Prism Kingdom Clan.

beats.headline: The sponsorship changes hands
beats.text: I sell my sponsorship of Princess Donut. It is not appropriate to sponsor a crawler I may be fighting, and it paid well. Whoever bought it will want something for their money, and that is a matter between the cat and the buyer now.
beats.gist: Empress D'nadia sells her sponsorship of Princess Donut for a high price.

beats.headline: Marked, and taken by the dinosaur
beats.text: Empress D'nadia of the Prism Kingdom, warlord of the Prism clan, is dead. Crawler Carl marked her with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering. Mongo did the rest. She said at the finish that everything she did she did for her people; he told her to her face that she did it for herself and that her people will pay for it. I am obliged to broadcast both halves of an exchange like that.
beats.gist: Carl marks Empress D'nadia with the Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering and Mongo kills her.

relations.note: The sponsor slot she sold is the one the tiara comes out of.
